Reṇu,
(1) (= Pali id., DN 〔ii.230.24 ff.〕), n. of the son and successor of King Diśāṃpati: Mv 〔iii.204.11 ff.〕 In LV 〔171.1〕 he seems to have the epithet Diśāṃpati himself, and further, by a confusion in the story, he is represented as a previous incarnation of Śākyamuni: Reṇu bhū (= abhūḥ) Diśāṃpati. In both the Mv and the Pali versions it is the purohita Jyotipāla (Mahāgovinda) who was the future Buddha. In Mvy 〔3580〕 called Sureṇu.
(2) n. of a former Buddha: LV 〔171.13〕.
